reviews.title: Best PC case on the market
reviews.comment: This is hands down the cleanest and easiest PC case to build in. I bought and built a Black and a White build for me and my son. Buy the LX-R with iCue setup. Cable management and aesthetically pleasing! You won’t regret it.
